metadata.name: Samira in Isaac!【R+ / REPENTOGON】
metadata.description: Samira with external GPU rendering and a compact native fallback. Auto Chinese/English UI, F10 control settings, mouse or WASD movement, dual-stick gamepad controls, single-target A-key attacks and rectangular passive thrusts, native Q weapon synergies, native coins and a 28-item crafting shop with original client artwork, recipe navigation and transaction undo. Heartsteel stacking and Blade of the Ruined King. Requires REPENTOGON. Fullscreen uses borderless composition. Independent numeric HP and fractional healing; native half-hearts convert to 50 HP, incoming damage scales by floor. R grants flight.
